facts.raw_span: 2-year history of episodic hypertension
micturition-related syncope
episodic chest pain, palpitations, and diaphoresis
Tachycardia (112 beats/min)
Blood pressure 196/120 mmHg
High-sensitivity troponin T: 936 ng/L, peaked at 1026 ng/L
Plasma free metanephrine levels: isolated elevation in plasma normetanephrine (36 nmol/L)
24-hour urinary metanephrines: isolated normetanephrine elevation (8990 mcg)
Free norepinephrine: 21,685 pg/mL
Bilateral crackles on pulmonary examination
Chest radiography: bilateral hilar opacities suggesting acute pulmonary edema
Transthoracic echocardiogram: mildly depressed left ventricular systolic function (EF 40-45%)
